A.description: Qualified production; owner wake under admission lock

B.description: Pinned owner wake outside admission lock; acceptance/FIFO/preparation unchanged

changed_condition.policy: Previous 24 blocks remain excluded in their original series. This is a new prospective experiment after a verified host-load change, with no pooling or replacement of old observations.

plan.entry_initialization: Fixed two-second settling interval after interpreter/import startup, then three consecutive standard quiet windows. Thresholds unchanged. Added before any performance sample; two rejected entry attempts are preserved and contain zero benchmark observations.
exclusions: Exclude both source blocks of a scenario/round if either has ERROR, NOISY or UNKNOWN, missing counters/oracles, or source/input/CPU geometry mismatch
Exclude both blocks if paired raw WRITE max/min spread exceeds 10%
No replacement observations, extra repeats or adaptive stopping for significance; preserve every measurement
plan.gate: Actual-body and loaded fault/suspend/GC gates passed; still requires exact-source make test if retained.
plan.guard_material_harm_screen: Flag a guard with point <= -3% useful throughput and pointwise 95% upper bound below zero; review before retention. This is descriptive screening, not a new family-adjusted harm claim.

host_configuration.storage: new owned RAM-backed null_blk service models; native host status does not establish physical NVMe fidelity

plan.hypothesis: Pinned owner notification outside the admission lock improves useful service by reducing notification-related serialization without changing FIFO, ownership, representation or lower-success publication.

matched_inputs.fixture_and_plan_hashes: Must match across sources; record before first timed sample
matched_inputs.models: Unchanged make fast_test RAM null_blk models; configured NVMe rates do not imply physical fidelity

plan.native_validation_scope: Full source contracts passed before pilot; each make fast_test block runs its standard window/native preflight, not repeated full source contracts. Common source files remain frozen.
next_correctness_gates: Full exact-source make test including ID36 if performance screen justifies retention

primary_family.direction_test: Exact two-sided signs; alpha=0.05/3, adjusted p=min(1,3*p)
primary_family.endpoint: Within-round B/A change in useful WRITE normalized by each source block own raw WRITE, using paired log ratios

plan.raw_target_order: raw-first in odd rounds, target-first in even rounds in both source blocks
plan.screen_decision: Advance only if NVMe5 point reaches +3%, its family interval is above zero and its family-adjusted sign p is below 0.05, with at least nine valid pairs. Any primary/guard material harm, unresolved correctness/resource issue or unexpected lower-IO geometry requires review before retention. Otherwise decline this variant without replacement sampling. Exact-source make test remains mandatory before retention.
plan.secondary: Pointwise descriptive 95% paired log intervals for useful READ, READ/WRITE p95/p99, independent lower bytes/requests, fast WRITE QD1/4/8, GC, CPU and memory. No new direction claims; do not add overlapping CPU/wall timers. Native task CPU excludes kernel workers.
plan.series: new native-host comparison after competing workload ended

secondary.scope: descriptive secondary; no family direction or equivalence claim
descriptive secondary; no family direction or equivalence claim
